source.title: Rowan - The Roamer
source.name: Rowan
source.description: A witty Support who is skilled at providing high Energy and HP recovery for allies.

skills.name: Fatal Greed

description.raw: Rowan moves up to 1 tile and throws coins upon reaching the destination, recovering 250 + 30 (SP-based) Energy for surrounding allies within 2 tiles.
active: Rowan moves up to 1 tile and throws coins upon reaching the destination, recovering 250 + 30 (SP-based) Energy for surrounding allies within 2 tiles.

text: Increases Energy recovery to 260 + 30 (SP-based).
Increases Energy recovery to 280 + 30 (SP-based).
Increases Energy recovery to 300 + 30 (SP-based).
Increases Energy recovery to 320 + 30 (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Rowan moves for some distance and continuously recovers Energy for nearby allies.

skills.name: Smart Stall

description.raw: Rowan places 2 health potions on his trolley when a battle starts. Allies within 2 tiles with HP ratio below 50% automatically use a potion to recover 40% + 4% (SP-based) of their max HP by up to 800% + 65% (SP-based) of Rowan's ATK. Each ally can use up to 1 health potion every 6s.
active: Rowan places 2 health potions on his trolley when a battle starts.
Allies within 2 tiles with HP ratio below 50% automatically use a potion to recover 40% + 4% (SP-based) of their max HP by up to 800% + 65% (SP-based) of Rowan's ATK.
Each ally can use up to 1 health potion every 6s.

text: Increases recovery amount to 42% + 4% (SP-based) of allies' max HP.
Places an energy potion when a battle starts.
When the Energy of an ally within 2 tiles exceeds 600, they automatically use this potion to recover 400 Energy.
Increases recovery amount to 45% + 4% (SP-based) of allies' max HP.

skills.description_lite: Rowan places health potions to recover HP for allies with low HP.

skills.name: Quack Waltz

description.raw: Rowan calls on Bradduck to attack an enemy, dealing 150% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage and absorbing 70 Energy.
active: Rowan calls on Bradduck to attack an enemy, dealing 150% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage and absorbing 70 Energy.

text: If all health potions have been used up, Bradduck no longer launches attack but instead replenishes Rowan's trolley with a health potion.
This effect can be triggered once every 3 times of Quack Waltz.
Increases damage to 190% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).
Increases damage to 230% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Rowan calls on Bradduck to attack and absorb Energy from an enemy, or replenish a health potion instead.

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Rowan increases his Haste by 7 during battle. His Haste is increased by an extra 6 before replenishing his trolley with Quack Waltz for the first time.
active: Rowan increases his Haste by 7 during battle.
His Haste is increased by an extra 6 before replenishing his trolley with Quack Waltz for the first time.

text: Rowan increases his Haste by 10 during battle.
His Haste is increased by an extra 8 before replenishing his trolley with Quack Waltz for the first time.
Rowan increases his Haste by 12 during battle.
His Haste is increased by an extra 10 before replenishing his trolley with Quack Waltz for the first time.

skills.description_lite: Rowan increases his Haste during battle, with an extra Haste bonus before Bradduck replenishes his health potions.

skills.name: Great Bargain

description.raw: After selling 3 health potions, Rowan places a super health potion that recovers 60% of an ally's max HP and permanently increases their Phys DEF and Magic DEF by 30%. This effect can only trigger once per battle.
active: After selling 3 health potions, Rowan places a super health potion that recovers 60% of an ally's max HP and permanently increases their Phys DEF and Magic DEF by 30%.
This effect can only trigger once per battle.

text: Increases the recovery amount of super health potion to 65% of the ally's max HP, permanently increasing their Phys DEF and Magic DEF by 35%.
When Bradduck replenishes the health potions, one turns into a super health potion, triggered 1 time per battle.
Increases the recovery amount of super health potion to 70% of the ally's max HP, permanently increasing their Phys DEF and Magic DEF by 40%.

skills.description_lite: Rowan places a super health potion that recovers an ally's HP and permanently increases their Phys DEF and Magic DEF.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Rowan places 1 more health potion when a battle starts using Smart Stall.
active: Rowan places 1 more health potion when a battle starts using Smart Stall.
